source: OpenAlex (api.openalex.org, group_by queries); population: UN World Population Prospects 2024
citation: Priem, J., Piwowar, H., & Orr, R. (2022). OpenAlex: A fully-open index of scholarly works, authors, venues, institutions, and concepts. arXiv:2205.01833
method: Works of type article, review or conference-paper, not retracted, whose primary location is a CWTS core source (primary_location.source.is_core), by publication year 2000–2025. Full counting by the countries of the authors' institutions (a paper with authors in two countries counts once for each). International co-authorship: countries_distinct_count > 1. Open access: open_access.is_oa. Highly cited: citation_normalized_percentile.is_in_top_10_percent (to 2024). Fields: primary_topic. Shares need at least 100 papers; per-capita needs a population of 100,000.
